title: Change to a personalised vessel registration number
summary: Learn how to apply to personalize your vessel's registration number.
intro:
To personalise your vessel's registration number, you'll need to complete and lodge an application form.

The requested number can be up to six alpha/numeric characters followed by the letter 'N'. You can call us on 13 77 88 to find out the availability of a number, or ask at a Service NSW Centre.
what_you_need: Current vessel registration details and certificate
The PDF form: 'Application to Personalise an Existing Vessel Registration'
A JP or authorised witness to confirm your signature on the form

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and submit your application.

faqs.q: What can the personalized vessel registration number look like?
faqs.a: The requested number can be up to six alpha/numeric characters followed by the letter 'N'.

faqs.q: How can I check if a personalized number is available?
faqs.a: You can call 13 77 88 or ask at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: Where can I submit my application?
faqs.a: You must visit a service centre to submit your application.
